caseName: Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs v. Greenwich Collieries
caseNameFull: Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs, Department of Labor v. Greenwich Collieries and Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs, Department of Labor v. Maher Terminals, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 510 U. S. 1068.] Motion of respondent Greenwich Collieries for reconsideration of order denying motion for divided argument [510 U. S. 1189] denied. Counsel for respondent Greenwich Collieries is designated to present oral argument on behalf of respondents.
